title: What the Customer Bears on a Claim Settled under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans
content:
On a settled claim under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans, what the customer bears out of pocket turns on whether a settlement already stands on the plan inside the window the coverage counts settlements over, being the 12 whole months to the handling date, and on whether the most recent inspection entry falls within the coverage's inspection interval.

Where no settlement entry stands on the plan inside that window and the whole months since the most recent inspection entry are within the coverage's inspection interval, nothing at all is charged to the customer. Where a settlement entry stands on the plan inside that window and the whole months since the most recent inspection entry are within the coverage's inspection interval, the customer bears the coverage's deductible at the repeat multiple, being 2 times the published deductible. In any other case the customer bears the coverage's deductible as published.

## The figures the plans publish

| Plan | Deductible published | Inspection interval, whole months |
|---|---|---|
| Manufacturer Limited Warranty | 0.00 USD | 12 |
| Belrose Care Plan 2-Year | 75.00 USD | 6 |
| Belrose Care Plan 3-Year | 50.00 USD | 6 |
| Belrose Care Plan 5-Year | 35.00 USD | 6 |
| Belrose Lifetime Care Plan | 0.00 USD | 6 |
| Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan | 0.00 USD | 4 |

## Basis questions

**A plan with one settlement booked five months ago and an inspection logged two months ago, the interval being 6 months.** A settlement stands inside the 12 whole months to the handling date and the inspection falls within the interval, so the customer bears 2 times the published deductible.

**The same plan with no settlement in those 12 months and that same inspection.** Nothing at all is charged to the customer.

**A plan whose most recent inspection entry is 9 whole months old, the interval being 6 months.** The inspection does not fall within the interval, so neither of the first two readings is reached and the customer bears the deductible as published.

**A plan publishing a deductible of 0.00 USD.** The published figure is nothing, so nothing is borne on every reading, the repeat multiple included.
